rule: This file is a TASK PLAN, not a log. Every entry names a measured defect and the model change that addresses it. Completed work and history live in git log and docs/HONEST_NEGATIVE_CATALOG.md. Nothing is DONE without an artifact path.
scope: CFM / generative line only. The predictive line is docs/PREDICTIVE_LINE_INDEX.md and is out of scope here.
principle: A defect that is a property of the model gets a model change, not a longer run. A defect that is a property of the measurement gets a measurement, not a model change. Which one it is has to be decided by a number, so every entry below carries one.

diagnosis.symptom: The velocity field never sees bond order, and the exact-type metric is structurally unreachable.
diagnosis.measured: c8 full corpus, epochs 0/1/2: bond_f1 0.960/0.991/0.995, bond_type_macro_f1_pooled 0.475/0.632/0.618 against an OpenBabel reference of 0.505, exact_type_rate 0.005/0.031/0.010. Same run logs bond_features=OFF: the decoder reads raw distance plus is_short/is_long, so the EGNN velocity field receives no bond order at all.
diagnosis.reading: Corrected 2026-10-25. The earlier version of this entry said macro_f1 was 0.000 and blamed the bond head; that number came from the 64-cloud gcv36 arm (0.0182 at epoch 0, 0.1125 at epoch 33), where the bond head has almost no data. On the full corpus the head is above the OpenBabel reference by epoch 0. So the defect is not bond-order prediction — it is that the order the head does predict is never fed back into the geometry field, and that exact_type (every bond in a ~45-bond complex correct) sits at its floor by construction.

diagnosis.symptom: Generated pools are fragments, not molecules.
diagnosis.measured: single_fragment_rate 0.2505 on the c8 pool (n=2112); 0.0851 on the c7 pool (n=12669). Real tmQM reference 1.0.
diagnosis.reading: Three quarters of the pool is two or more disconnected pieces. No sampling-side fix can recover a molecule that was never connected.

diagnosis.symptom: The ring system is wrong even where the molecule is connected.
diagnosis.measured: three_ring_share 0.6684 and six_ring_share 0.0292 on c7 (n=12669); real tmQM 0.0001 and 0.8753.
diagnosis.reading: 67% of all rings are three-membered. That is the signature of a decoder closing triangles among atoms that happen to be near each other, not of a learned ring prior.

diagnosis.symptom: The metal-ligand geometry is not physical.
diagnosis.measured: sampled metal_ligand_min 1.234 A against a real 1.953; min_pair_distance 0.570 against 1.172; frac_pairs_hard_clash 0.0148 against 0.0; 143 hard-clash pairs across 24 clouds. SMOKE SCALE: 24 clouds, 20 steps, one checkpoint.
diagnosis.reading: A 1.23 A metal-ligand distance is shorter than any Pt/Ru/Ir donor bond. The field has no per-metal geometry prior, so nothing in the objective prefers 2.0 A over 1.2 A.

diagnosis.symptom: M4 fails at t=0.50 only, because its reference is a single shared slope.
diagnosis.measured: The old reference, cfm_module_gates._bayes_ratio, fits ONE slope v ~ a*x_t shared by all three coordinates. The cohort's per-axis variance is 16.95 / 2.67 / 1.60 A^2, so the three optimal slopes have opposite signs (+0.93, -0.79, -1.18 at t=0.50) and the shared one averages to 0.0675. The per-axis closed-form optimum at the same t is 0.4786, a factor of 7.09. An independent k-NN estimate of E[v|x_t] returns 0.5358 (254 clouds, k=32, 5D features), i.e. 1.12x the per-axis value, so the non-linear part is 12% and the restriction is the rest. Corrected, M4 PASSES at all five t on both 36-epoch arms (0.80/0.90/0.66/0.59/0.78 of the per-axis reference on gcv36, 0.83/0.89/0.63/0.57/0.81 on budget36).
diagnosis.reading: The field was never over-emitting at the midpoint. M4 was comparing it to a reference that discards two thirds of the signal on an anisotropic cohort. The shared-slope error is largest exactly at t=0.50 (7.09x) and negligible at the ends (1.00x at t=0.05, 1.00x at t=0.95), which is why only one of the five t values ever failed.

diagnosis.symptom: Conditioning is connected but never shown to be satisfied.
diagnosis.measured: M2 shows a metal swap changes the output by 43.5% and a t shift by 106.9%; nothing measures whether a sample conditioned on (metal, coordination number) actually has that metal in that coordination.
diagnosis.reading: A generator whose selling point is metal-awareness has to be scored on the condition being met, not on the output moving.

diagnosis.symptom: Diversity and novelty are unmeasurable at the cohort sizes on disk.
diagnosis.measured: IntDiv1 0.869 at n=37, with the artifact's own note that the MOSES comparison needs n>=1000 and that an n=37 sample of the training data itself already sits at 0.885. Novelty has never been measured.
diagnosis.reading: Not a model defect and not a result either: the cohort is too small for the metric to mean anything.

diagnosis.measured: Zero published metal-complex generators are run on this corpus. The only comparator in the repo is the metal-blind ablation, which has never been run at this protocol.
diagnosis.reading: Without a comparator the pool numbers have no scale. The cheapest defensible one is the same model with metal identity removed from every input, because it isolates the paper's claim.

diagnosis.symptom: Property quality is far outside any publishable band.
diagnosis.measured: SA 6.44 and QED 0.094 on n=66 survivors of the free-generation panel (one seed, one checkpoint).
diagnosis.reading: A consequence, not an independent defect: a fragmented 3-ring-dominant pool cannot score well on either. No separate module is planned; the targets are pool-level acceptance tests on MOD1-MOD4.
diagnosis.done_when: SA <= 4.5 and QED >= 0.30 on a >=1000-molecule pool

diagnosis.symptom: The measurement chain does not identify its own checkpoint.
diagnosis.measured: On the gcv36 arm the configured criterion bond_exact_type read 0.000 at all 36 epochs, so best_epoch was 0 while the run reached epoch 35; the gates then loaded _last.pt (sha 23d5be27) while per_epoch_metrics.json named seed0.pt (sha 0550a84b) and M10 failed the hash check. The same run's bond_type_macro_f1_pooled moved 0.0182 to 0.1125 over those epochs, and its gen_validity_n was 0 (no generation eval), so the signal existed and the criterion did not use it.
diagnosis.reading: Two defects wearing one symptom. The chain half: the gates loaded a file the artifact did not name, so the hash check compared two epochs. Fixed on 2026-10-25 — the gates now load the artifact-named checkpoint, and M10 passes on the re-gated run. The selection half: bond_exact_type cannot move, so 'best' meant 'first'. Fixed in three places — the config must name a criterion that moves (bond_type_f1, measured 0.018 to 0.113 on this arm), resolve_selection selects the final epoch when a criterion is constant and records provenance.selection, and the pool numbers are re-measured on whatever checkpoint the artifact names.

diagnosis.symptom: A 64-cloud arm reaches 42.5 GB and OOMs the host.
diagnosis.measured: anon-rss 35.79 GB (pid 2513370, 13:54:34) and 42.52 GB (pid 2581802, 15:52:07). With fm_ode_term_weight 0.0 the same arm peaks at 5.28 GB and oscillates 2.1-4.6 GB. MEASURED 2026-10-25 (metrics/by_metric/wfa109_fmode_graph_retention_long.json, 160 steps at 405 atoms): the live-tensor count is constant at 382 and the RSS slope decays from 17.7 MB/step over 40 steps to 4.76 over 160, so nothing accumulates. The 16 graphs cost 232 MB each at 405 atoms (3.72 GB per step, metrics/by_metric/wfa110_fmode_checkpoint_peaks.json), which at the 2,957-atom batch is ~27 GB on top of a 5.28 GB base - the observed peak.
diagnosis.reading: The reading in v11.0 ('bounded at 16 graphs, so the retention is across steps') was wrong, and the measurement says so. There is no leak: the live-tensor count is flat over 160 steps and the RSS slope decays as the allocator's arena reaches its working-set size. The term is a per-step budget that scales with atom count, and the only lever is to stop storing the stage activations. Checkpointing them cuts the added peak 3.3x (3.72 GB -> 1.12 GB per step at 405 atoms).

modules.name: TypedEdgeField
modules.where: molmetal/adapters/flow_matching_lipman/ (EGNNVelocityField edge features) + the decode path that supplies the predicted order
modules.change: Feed the bond order the head already predicts back into the EGNN as a typed edge feature. No new order head: MEASURED on the c8 full corpus the head reaches macro-F1(type) 0.475/0.632/0.618 at epochs 0/1/2 against an OpenBabel reference of 0.505, while the same run logs bond_features=OFF, so the field reads raw distance plus is_short/is_long and the order never reaches the coordinates. The change is the edge-feature path, a checkpoint that declares whether it has it, and a decode step that uses the same order logits the metric scores.
modules.done_when: on the same c8 protocol: an on/off ablation of the typed-edge path changes the velocity field's output on identical inputs (M2-style perturbation, >= 1e-2), single_fragment_rate and three_ring_share move in the expected direction, and bond_type_macro_f1 does not fall below 0.618.
modules.risk: Typed edges change the EGNN's input width, so every existing checkpoint needs a fresh run or a migration. The effect may also be nil: if the ring and fragment errors come from the sampler rather than the field, giving the field order information changes nothing measurable.
modules.result: The path is wired, opt-in, and trains: a zero-initialised rank-5 projection per layer, added to the edge input, with a per-cloud presence mask so a withheld order is the untyped field exactly. MEASURED ablation on the smoke arm (64 clouds, CPU): the projection leaves zero and the order moves the velocity by 0.22% at 2 epochs, 0.39% at 8, 0.50% at 20 - below the 1e-2 bar, and sublinear, so the training budget is not the lever at this scale.
modules.open_question: Whether the channel is weak by construction or unused by a 64-cloud fit. The 20-epoch projection norm is 0.002 against an Adam step of 1e-3 over 160 steps, i.e. the gradient is mostly cancelled: the FM regression does not need the order to fit 64 clouds. The full-corpus arm is where the question is answerable.

modules.name: GeometryConsistencyTerm
modules.change: LANDED 2026-10-25. One differentiable term evaluated on x1_hat, not on the training x1, with three parts: non-bonded pairs below 0.7*(rcov_i+rcov_j); bonded pairs outside [0.85, 1.25] x (rcov_i+rcov_j); metal-ligand pairs outside the per-metal band from MOD3. Each part is a hinge-squared mean over the pairs that exist, so a satisfied pair contributes exactly zero. Master weight plus three part weights, all defaulting to 0.0/1.0 and therefore bit-exact for every existing config. Registered in _LAST_LOSS_TERMS as geometry_term so the liveness guard and the M9 share table see it.
modules.done_when: on a >=1000-molecule pool: single_fragment_rate >= 0.80, frac_pairs_hard_clash <= 0.001, metal_ligand_min in [1.7, 2.4] A.
modules.risk: A strong attraction term collapses the cloud; the weight needs a 3-point budget sweep before any result is quoted.

modules.name: MetalGeometryPrior
modules.where: molmetal/loss/geometry_consistency.py (METAL_ML_BAND_A), consumed by MOD2's third part
modules.change: LANDED 2026-10-25 as the band table, not as a learned prior. MEASURED p10/p90 of the metal-ligand distance per metal from the REAL_DFT cohort in metrics/by_metric/cfm_metal_geometry.json: Pt 1.979-2.466 (n=3571), Ru 1.939-2.371 (5723), Ir 2.005-2.360 (3549), Rh 1.995-2.351 (2374), Os 1.870-2.439 (844), Re 1.938-2.427 (2457). MOD2 penalises an M-L pair outside its own metal's band, so the prior is metal-specific rather than one constant. Not yet fed into the field as a conditioning vector: that needs a CN head, which is MOD5.
modules.done_when: median M-L distance within 0.15 A of the DFT per-metal median on the metals held out of the prior fit.
modules.risk: Some metals have few rows; the per-metal median has to carry its own n and be reported with it.

modules.name: RingSizePrior
modules.change: Enumerate candidate cycles in the predicted bond graph, featurise each by size, planarity and the MOD1 bond orders, predict a plausibility score, and rescore the edges that close it. Train on truth graphs with the spurious triangles the current decoder emits as explicit negatives.
modules.done_when: on a >=1000-molecule pool: three_ring_share <= 0.10 and six_ring_share >= 0.45, with single_fragment_rate not falling below its MOD2 value.
modules.risk: A cycle prior applied at decode can only reject edges; if the coordinate field already placed atoms in a triangle, rejection lowers connectivity. Order MOD2 before MOD4.

modules.name: ConditionEncoder
modules.where: molmetal/adapters/flow_matching_lipman/ (metal embedding table) + new coordination head
modules.change: Extend the metal conditioning table from metal identity to (metal, coordination number) pairs; add a coordination-number head so the realised CN is measurable; add classifier-free guidance with a config-keyed scale so the condition can be strengthened at sample time.
modules.done_when: given (metal, CN), >=60% of samples match both, metal retention >=0.95, and the guidance scale is reported with the number it was measured at.
modules.risk: Guidance trades diversity for adherence; both numbers have to be reported together or the metric is gameable.
modules.note: The coordination-number HEAD in `change` was not built, and the substitution is deliberate: the realised CN is read from the metal's degree in the decoded RDKit molecule. A head predicts what the field thinks; the done_when is about the sample, and on a generated sample the graph IS the answer. Building a head would add a second, weaker measurement of the same thing.

modules.name: MagnitudeCalibrationHead
modules.change: Replace the scalar channel gate with a per-t magnitude head whose target is the measured conditional-mean envelope from MOD7, trained with an auxiliary loss on |v_pred| against that envelope. Only build this if MOD7 says the field is over-emitting; if MOD7 says the envelope is larger than the linear bound, the gate is re-anchored instead and this module is not built.
modules.done_when: M4 PASS at all five t values on a trained arm, or a recorded decision that the band was wrong with the MOD7 number as the evidence.
modules.risk: Fitting the gate to the envelope is close to fitting the metric. The envelope must be measured on data the field was not trained on.
modules.decision: MOD7 measured the envelope at 1.02-1.28x the corrected reference at every t and every cohort size (8 / 63 / 252 clouds). It never approaches M4's 2.0x ceiling, so there is no measured over-emission for a magnitude head to correct. Re-anchoring the reference was the whole fix.

modules.name: NonparametricEnvelope
modules.change: Estimate E[v|x_t] nonparametrically at the five M4 t values, by k-NN over x_t on a held-out split, and report |E[v|x_t]| / |v| next to the linear-Gaussian bayes_ratio. This is a measurement, not a model change; it decides whether MOD6 is built.
modules.done_when: one artifact carrying both ratios at t = 0.05/0.25/0.50/0.75/0.95, with the held-out split fingerprint and the k used.
modules.risk: k-NN in 3N dimensions is weak; the estimate is a lower bound too, and has to be reported as one.

modules.name: DiversityAndNoveltySampler
modules.where: trainer diversity flags (6, all wired, all default OFF) + cfm_property_panel.py
modules.change: Run a measured ablation over the six wired diversity knobs instead of leaving them off; add scaffold conditioning so a pool can be drawn per scaffold; produce a >=1000-molecule pool and score novelty against the training corpus with an n-matched control.
modules.done_when: n>=1000 pool, novelty fraction >=0.90, IntDiv1 reported against an n-matched training-distribution control, not against MOSES.
modules.risk: None of the six knobs has ever been shown to help; the ablation may return six nulls, which is a legitimate outcome to record.

modules.name: MetalBlindAblation
modules.where: config-only: metal_conditioning=none with the metal atom type masked
modules.change: Run the same protocol with metal identity removed from every input. This is the comparator the paper's claim needs: it isolates metal-awareness from everything else in the architecture.
modules.done_when: paired comparison on >=3 seeds of (metal-aware, metal-blind) on single_fragment_rate, three_ring_share, metal retention and bond_type_macro_f1.
modules.risk: A re-implementation of a published external generator is still missing and is not covered by this module.

tasks.title: A selected checkpoint the criterion can actually rank
tasks.what: Three changes, each measured. (1) The criterion: the arm was configured with bond_exact_type, which is structurally 0.000, while bond_type_macro_f1_pooled moved 0.0182 to 0.1125 over the same 36 epochs. Every config in this line now names bond_type_f1. (2) The chain: the gates loaded _last.pt while the artifact named seed0.pt, so M10 compared two epochs and reported the difference as a broken chain. The gates now load the artifact-named checkpoint (cfm_module_gates._artifact_named_ckpt). (3) The guard: resolve_selection selects the final epoch when a criterion's history holds one distinct value, and writes provenance.selection so the artifact says which case it is.
tasks.done_when: M10 PASS on a run written after the change, whose per_epoch_metrics.json carries provenance.selection with either degenerate false or selected_checkpoint last, and whose declared sha equals the sha of the file it names.

tasks.title: Find the retention inside FmOdeTerm
tasks.what: Find the retention inside FmOdeTerm. It holds 16 forward graphs per step, which is bounded, yet RSS grows monotonically to 42.5 GB. Instrument the term's lifetime across steps and fix the retainer; keep fm_ode_term_weight 0.0 in every arm until then.
tasks.done_when: a 2-epoch run at fm_ode_term_weight 0.05 under an 8 GB RSS ceiling completes with the watchdog not firing, and the growth curve is an artifact.
tasks.result: The leak hypothesis is refuted and the memory is bounded. FmOdeTerm checkpoints its four stage forwards (use_checkpoint=True), which is numerically exact including under dropout (6 tests) and cuts the term's added peak 3.3x at 405 atoms (3,718 -> 1,120 MB, three separate processes). MEASURED end to end: the 64-cloud, 2-epoch arm at 0.05 now completes at a 9,747 MB peak against the 42.52 GB that OOMed the host, with the term live at 0.50% of the loss.
tasks.note: done_when's 8 GB ceiling is missed by 1.7 GB at 64 clouds (4,510 MB of term on a 5,237 MB base) and met at 8 clouds (2,501 MB). Getting under 8 GB at 64 clouds needs n_steps below 4 - 16 forwards is n_steps squared - which changes the term, or a smaller batch. Not done: that decision is the user's, because the term is only 0.5-0.7% of the objective.

tasks.title: The measurement arm every other task is scored on
tasks.what: One measurement arm that everything else is scored on: full corpus (26715 clouds), batch 64, 18 epochs, the c8 split, 3 seeds, FmOdeTerm off, gen_eval_n >= 1000 with the pool saved.
tasks.done_when: 3 checkpoints + per-epoch metrics + a >=1000-molecule pool per seed, each with the provenance block, and the same n_test fingerprint across seeds.
tasks.blocked_note: and the host must be checked with free -m and launched under an RSS ceiling.
tasks.probe: 2026-10-26 memory probe (metrics/by_metric/wfa113_t3_memory_probe.json). With FmOdeTerm off, the 26,715-cloud cohort loads into 3.66 GB of host RSS and batch 64 reaches 23.6 GB of VRAM on a card already holding 31 GB of another user's work: it does not OOM. Both probes were stopped before completing an epoch, so 23.6 GB is a floor and no wall clock was measured. The observed step time was >40x the c8 record, on a contended card.
tasks.open_decision: T3's config must also declare metal_conditioning. The c8 reference does not, and the argparse default is `none`, so that reference and every acceptance.rows[].now number come from a METAL-BLIND model. Building T3 from c8 unchanged yields a third metal-blind arm and leaves MOD9/T11's metal-aware arm missing. T3 is also 22,572 optimiser steps (418 x 18 x 3 seeds), which is a multi-day launch on a shared card, not a 4.5-hour one.
tasks.per_step_cost: 2026-10-26 (Wf-A114, metrics/by_metric/wfa114_velocity_forward_count.json). The '>40x the c8 record' reading above was half an explanation. One optimiser step evaluated the velocity field 11 times and only 1 was the main FM term: shortcut_distillation recomputed it (its first term IS the FM regression, and it was ADDED again on top of fm_term, so the FM MSE entered the total at 2 x fm_weight while fm_weight still read 1.0), consistency recomputed it as its clean pass, EDM recomputed it as pred_raw, EnergyConservation recomputed it as v0, and SBOO3Term recomputed it inside the rotation loop. All five are exact recomputations of a tensor the step already had; the field carries dropout, so each also returned a different sample than the one the main loss was fitted to. After the fix the step costs 7 forwards (main 1, so3 2, shortcut 1, consistency 1, energy 1, sboo3 1). Wall clock could not be A/B'd: the same one-batch CPU profile measured batch_total 13354 -> 33159 -> 32918 ms over the same interval while doing strictly less work, so the host was 2.5x slower by the third run.

tasks.title: Measure the conditional-mean envelope (decides MOD6)
tasks.what: MOD7: measure the nonparametric conditional-mean envelope at the five M4 t values on a held-out split. CPU only, no training.
tasks.done_when: artifact with |E[v|x_t]|/|v| and the linear-Gaussian bayes_ratio side by side at all five t, plus the split fingerprint.
tasks.result: Shared-slope reference is 7.09x too small at t=0.50; the per-axis optimum and a k-NN estimate agree to 12%. M4 re-gated PASS on both arms.

tasks.title: MOD1: typed edges, no new order head
tasks.what: MOD1: feed the predicted bond order into the EGNN as typed edge features, and prove the field's output depends on them. The order head is not rebuilt: it is already above the OpenBabel reference on the full corpus (0.618 vs 0.505 at c8 epoch 2).
tasks.done_when: the on/off ablation moves the field's output by >= 1e-2 on identical inputs, single_fragment_rate and three_ring_share move in the expected direction, and bond_type_macro_f1 stays >= 0.618 on the c8 protocol.
tasks.blocked_note: needs the measurement arm to be comparable.
tasks.result: Typed edges implemented and ablated. The ablation does NOT reach the done_when threshold at smoke scale: 0.0050 against 1e-2 at 20 epochs.

tasks.title: MOD2 + MOD3: geometry consistency term
tasks.what: MOD2 + MOD3: geometry consistency term on the sampled x1_hat, with the per-metal M-L band as its third part. Code landed 2026-10-25 (molmetal/loss/geometry_consistency.py + four YAML weights + 8 unit tests). Remaining: a 3-point weight sweep on the 64-cloud arm with gen_eval on, then the >=1000-molecule pool.
tasks.done_when: single_fragment_rate >= 0.80, frac_pairs_hard_clash <= 0.001, metal_ligand_min in [1.7, 2.4] A on a >=1000-molecule pool, with the sweep table as the evidence for the weight.
tasks.note: MOD2/MOD3 are live: geometry_term 2.4686 -> 1.1543 over two epochs of the smoke arm, 7.7% -> 4.4% of train_loss, zero fallback warnings. The 3-point weight sweep is still open.

tasks.title: MOD4: ring-size prior at decode
tasks.what: MOD4: ring-size prior at decode, trained with the spurious triangles as negatives. Built as a DECODE-TIME gate instead: the selector is greedy and sequential, so the ring a candidate pair would close is exact (shortest path between its endpoints in the bonds accepted so far, plus one) and a closure below min_ring_size is refused. No retrain, no loss term.
tasks.done_when: three_ring_share <= 0.10 and six_ring_share >= 0.45 with single_fragment_rate not below its T6 value.
tasks.blocked_note: a cycle prior can only remove edges; connectivity has to be there first.
tasks.result: MEASURED (3 pools x 256 clouds, one 20-epoch smoke checkpoint, prior-on vs prior-off on the same generated geometry). Prior off: ring_3 0.291, ring_6 0.082, ring_5_6 0.148, 1.45 rings/mol, single_fragment 0.038, decode_ratio 1.000. min_ring_size=5: ring_3 0.000, ring_6 0.259, ring_5_6 0.476, 0.85 rings/mol, single_fragment 0.064, decode_ratio 1.000. min_ring_size=4: ring_3 0.000, ring_6 0.111, ring_5_6 0.217, 1.17 rings/mol. Per-seed 5+6 share at min=5: 0.516 / 0.457 / 0.464. The prior refused 674 of 18,245 considered candidates in 350 of 768 clouds; no cloud gained a three-ring (226 fell, 0 rose); five-rings 74 -> 142 and six-rings 91 -> 169.
tasks.note: The gate is HALF met: three_ring_share 0.000 (<=0.10) and single_fragment rose rather than fell, but six_ring_share 0.259 is below 0.45, and rings/mol falls to 0.85 against real tmQM's 4.19. Both misses are the pool's: this checkpoint gives 1.45 rings/mol to begin with, and the prior can only keep the rings the geometry offers. tasks.done_when: >=60% of samples match a requested (metal, CN), metal retention >=0.95, guidance scale reported with the number.
tasks.result: Code landed 2026-10-26. CNConditioner (one embedding row per CN, row 0 zero), coordination_number_from_bonds on the LOCAL per-cloud bond frame, cn_conditioning / cn_max / cn_conditioning_dropout / cn_cfg_scale / cn_request_override wired through the model, the loss and the sampler, conditional_success measured from the metal's degree in the decoded RDKit molecule. 56-step three-arm smoke: null request reproduces the OFF arm to 2.9e-07 relative at epoch 0, the ON arm moves epoch-0 loss by 2.1e-04, and the request reaches the field at 1.0%-54% relative velocity change (all 40 cells above the 1e-2 bar). The decode does NOT obey at 7 epochs: the dose-response range of mean decoded CN across requests 2/4/6 is 0.078 at cfg 1.0 and 0.125 at cfg 2.0 against a requested spread of 4.
tasks.note: The done_when as written is gameable and must be re-read before it is scored. MEASURED: request 2 scores conditional_success 0.750 while requests 4 and 6 score 0.062 and 0.031, and the decoded mean CN is ~2.13 in all three cells. The model emits a metal with ~2 bonds whatever is asked, so 'request the modal CN' clears 60% on a channel that does not steer. The gate is the dose-response range across requests plus metal_retention, not one cell. Obedience itself needs the T3 checkpoint.
